decisions.value: One card, one frame, id PodcastCard.compact
decisions.reason: fixtures/reference/Mini Jetcaster.dc.html renders the six declared PodcastCard states side by side inside the one section named PodcastCard, so ?frame=PodcastCard yields six instances of every node. A golden emitter needs exactly one instance, which is the whole reason this board exists instead of the reference one.

the single card this board renders is the data-props default set: subscribed false, selected false, force empty. The other five states the reference manifest declares belong to the reference state sheet, not to this frame.

measured off this board, not chosen. It comes from the card template's own $preview width 180 and the reference board's 168px-wide column plus the frame's padding; the frame is 24px on a side and the card fills it.

decisions.value: Roboto 400/500 and Material Symbols Outlined inlined as @font-face from .vendor/, with the latin subset under ./fonts/
decisions.reason: the reference export loads both from fonts.googleapis.com. The vendor router refuses anything .vendor/vendor-lock.json does not pin, and css-inline-no-external plus no-remote-links-emitted both call a remote stylesheet an error, so an honest offline fixture has to carry the faces itself. The runtime already re-emits these links as a style element at render time.

decisions.value: @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) appended to this fixture's tokens.css
decisions.reason: dark-reachable-prefers-color-scheme errors on a dark scheme that only a script can reach. The block restates the .md-dark roles so a dark OS preference reaches the same scheme with no script, and it lives in tokens.css because that is the only file allowed to hold a literal color.

decisions.value: the two style-hover attributes dropped from the card
decisions.reason: states-as-markup calls a state that only a hover reaches a state no code gets. The card already declares that state as a selectable prop: force takes hover, focus, hoverToggle and focusToggle and renderVals maps them to the same two surfaceContainer tiers.

decisions.value: the cover's category label placed with grid instead of position: absolute
decisions.reason: layout-flex-grid-only allows absolute only for a declared overlay, and the contract has no machine-readable overlay declaration yet. The cover became a one-cell grid; the label keeps the same space8 inset and the same measured box.

invented: the frame id PodcastCard.compact: the reference manifest names the card PodcastCard and states six states, and manifest-frames-declared wants a width class in the id, so this fixture adds the .compact segment the card's own $preview width of 180 supports. Nothing in the reference export names a width class for a single card.
the board file name Annotated.dc.html: no reference file is a single-card board, so this one had to be named.

data-component values podcast-card, podcast-card-cover, podcast-card-title and podcast-card-subscribe-toggle: names-kebab-ascii requires ASCII kebab-case, and SCREENS.md names these four parts of the card (Container, Cover placeholder, Text, Subscribe toggle). The reference export writes no data-component anywhere.

data-elevation="1" on the card root: SCREENS.md specifies a filled Card, which is elevation 1 in M3, and the export paints it as a surfaceContainer tier rather than as a shadow, so the level is read from the design intent and not measured off a box-shadow.

data-region="content" on the frame wrapper: this fixture's board is the only thing that could carry one, since region-intent-declared's allowed values name Scaffold regions of a screen and a single card is none of them.
